body:
## What this page is

This is Klook's route page for the bullet train from Tokyo to Hiroshima. It shows the day's departures with times and starting prices, and sells Shinkansen tickets for them. The page says the route has no transfers.

## Time

The shortest journey on the page is 3 hours 39 minutes and the average is 3 hours 49 minutes. The first departures we read were Nozomi services at 06:00, from Shinagawa Station and from Tokyo Station, and the page said 109 trains were scheduled for 14 October 2026.

## Price

Tickets ranged from US$130.90 to US$195.24 with an average of US$163.07. Every departure we read started at US$130.90, and the page adds that final prices vary with availability and time slot and are confirmed at checkout.

## What the tickets carry

Each departure listed is marked with QR code boarding and as a changeable ticket. The text we read did not set out the change rules or fees, so check them at checkout.

## How it differs from Kyoto

Hiroshima is further than Kyoto, so the ride is nearly twice as long and the fare higher. The Tokyo to Kyoto page on this site shows a fastest journey of 2 hours and a lower starting price. If you can only spare a day, compare the two before you plan.

## When it fits

It suits a long-distance trip that you want booked in advance, with a QR code on your phone instead of a paper ticket. If your itinerary is flexible, look at the hub page for starting prices on other routes.
